question: Should this session-state timing change require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the current source-level and test-only proof?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot safely waive the external-PR real-behavior proof gate for a user-visible session-state race without explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or a maintainer adds redacted Feishu DM output or comparable runner logs showing the fixed path on this PR head.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge based on the source and focused tests, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven here.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no real transport or production-runner proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor or a maintainer adds redacted Feishu DM output or comparable runner logs showing the fixed path on this PR head.
